selection: three named river/stream gages with publicly listed recent multiyear water-temperature links; fixed from site-page metadata before reading observations or model errors

sites.limitation: provider says this site no longer has year-round temperature measurement; timing and earlier records require verification
earlier 2001-2016 file is from the old upstream bridge and will not be mixed with the modern site
single creek within Walla Walla watershed, not an independent climate sample

screen: identify temperature table links and water-year coverage without reading time-series observations; before any reconstruction require source clock, unique subdaily samples, finite nonestimated quality-assured temperature, sensor documentation and catchment/prior-contact audits
timing_and_qa: pages describe QA/QC downloads but also mark all data as provisional; reconcile provider quality and version descriptions; do not assume observations are certified from existence of a file
network_independence: all three sites in the Walla Walla watershed and may share donors and weather; treat as a single related group absent evidence otherwise; compare against all prior source identities, river-network data and coordinate inventories
rights: no clear source-specific redistribution terms yet; source files and detailed station-year derivatives stay local until clarified
interpretation: metadata availability and later qualification are exploratory; not independent accuracy confirmation
